operation.description:
Provisions or updates a TLS certificate for the site.

**Creating a certificate (site has no certificate):**
- Omit certificate params to initiate Let's Encrypt provisioning
- Provide certificate, key, and ca_certificates to upload a custom certificate

**Updating a certificate (site already has a certificate):**
- REQUIRES certificate, key, and ca_certificates to replace with a new custom certificate
- Use POST /api/v1/sites/{site_id}/ssl/renew to renew an existing Let's Encrypt certificate
operation.title: Provision Site T L S Certificate
operation.x-display-name: Provision Site T L S Certificate

certificate.description: PEM-encoded certificate. Required when updating an existing certificate.

key.description: PEM-encoded private key. Required when updating an existing certificate.

ca_certificates.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate chain. Required when updating an existing certificate.

query_json.description: Documented Netlify parameters: ca_certificates, certificate, key
query_json.title: Query Parameters (JSON)
